fields.Name: Owner / AE
fields.Description: The account executive who owns the deal. THE OWNER ROLE: exactly one member per deal may hold it, and Deal.OwnerEmployeeID is the server-maintained stamp of whoever does. DefaultAttributionPct is 100 because owner-role attribution is the only default that reconciles to total bookings.

fields.Name: Sales Engineer
fields.Description: Technical validation and solution design. AllowsMultiplePerDeal is 1 — two SEs on one deal is normal, which is exactly the case that makes this a flag rather than a hardcoded rule.

fields.Name: SDR
fields.Description: Sourced or qualified the opportunity. Present on the team for attribution and coverage reporting even after handoff.

fields.Name: Executive Sponsor
fields.Description: Internal executive cover for a strategic deal.

fields.Name: Partner Manager
fields.Description: Manages the partner relationship on a partner-sourced deal. THIS IS THE ROLE THAT FORCED D-6: the holder is routinely a partner rep or contractor rather than an Employee, which is why DealTeamMember carries a nullable PersonID beside EmployeeID with an exactly-one-of CHECK.

fields.Name: CS Lead
fields.Description: Customer-success owner brought in pre-close, typically on renewals and expansions.
